Hi Amelia / Rajiv,

Following up on our brief trade conversation at EdgeAI — CloudPulse and Redwood share a lot of overlapping enterprise customers and we think theres a strong signal for a co-hosted executive roundtable series in Q1. High-level idea: a three-city roadshow (San Francisco, Seattle, Austin) targeting 40-60 senior platform/ML+infra owners per stop, with a single executive panel, two customer case studies, and 30–40 minute demo rotations.

As a starting ask from CloudPulse: wed request MDF to cover shared venue costs and a joint nurture campaign. In return well gladly: co-market via Redwood channels, provide a sponsored session, and include CloudPulse in targeted outbound to overlapping accounts.

Attached: draft_agenda.pdf (single-page steering doc) — includes proposed dates and high-level audience profile. Quick asks:
- Can CloudPulse commit to a single point of contact for logistics?
- Are you open to a 50/50 MDF split or prefer a fixed co-sponsorship number?
- Any blackouts for your execs in Feb–Mar?

If this looks promising Ill loop in Ben (budget) and Marissa (field ops) to lock logistics and a formal SOW.

Best,
Rafael

Rafael / Marissa — quick cost shakeout after running venue quotes and historic CPMs for similar roadshows:

Estimated per-city cost (mid-range venues, 40–60 pax):
- Venue rental + basic AV: $8,000
- F&B (light breakfast + coffee + lunch): $6,000
- On-site staff & demo tables: $2,500
- Paid promotion (geo-targeted ads + list rental): $6,000
- Travel/lodging for 3 speakers (economy): $3,500
Total per city: ~$26,000
Three-city total: ~$78,000

Proposed MDF ask to CloudPulse: $45,000 (covers venue + paid promotion across all three stops). Redwood covers speaker travel and basic booth ops (~$33k). We can offer CloudPulse a 10x CPL target (nets to 400–600 in nurture over 6 weeks) and two dedicated demo slots per city.

SOW: I put a short skeleton in the draft SOW (sow_cloudpulse_redwood.docx) — includes payment milestones (50% on signing, 50% 30 days after final event). If legal needs a changeset we should be prepared to allow 60–90 day net per their ask.

If that MDF number is acceptable Ill finalize the SOW and the quick win marketing playbook.

—Ben
